texts.zh:
发现了我们在他们的[GetPreFTLLower]星球上的行动后，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的许多[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]国家暂时放下彼此间的争吵，共同组建了一个跨国界军事组织。

根据当地媒体报道，这个特遣组织的主要责任是保卫他们的[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]免受“未知外星势力针对[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]全体的敌对活动”。
texts.en:
In an apparent response to our operations on their [GetPreFTLLower] world, many of the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName] nation states on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have momentarily put aside their squabbling to form a new supranational military organization.

According to local media, this task force has been charged with defending their [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat] from "hostile activities perpetrated by an unknown alien agency against the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName] species as a whole."

label.zh: 令人不安。
label.en: Disconcerting.

texts.zh:
我们位于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上方的观测站的侦测画面显示，[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]的地表新建了一批新的军事基地和雷达设施，这些营区全都归[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]建立的跨国界反外星特遣部队所管辖。

我们注意到，这些国家正在以前所未有的等级通力合作，我们派去执行绑架任务的飞行器现在经常受到这支部队的大气层战斗机拦截。尽管我们在技术上占优，但他们数量是如此之多，仍然成功击落了几架我们的绑架用穿梭机！
texts.en:
Reconnaissance footage taken by our Observation Post above [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has confirmed the construction of several new military bases and radar facilities on the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface, all under the control of the supranational anti-alien task force recently founded by the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

We are seeing an unprecedented level of cooperation between their nation states, and our abduction flights are now being routinely intercepted by atmospheric fighters belonging to this force. Despite our technological edge, their sheer numbers have enabled them to bring down several of our abduction shuttles!

label.zh: 这会妨碍我们的主动观察行动。
label.en: This will impair our aggressive observation activities.

texts.zh:
我们在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上空的观测站被毁了！[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]反外星特遣部队控制的一个军事基地向我们的观测站发射了一枚巨大的地对宇导弹。

考虑到我们之前已经通过大量的预防措施，把我们观测站的存在对[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]隐藏了起来，我们现在还不能确定他们到底用什么方法追踪到了观测站的位置。有人认为，是原住民设法从被击落的我方穿梭机上通过逆向工程掠夺了一些科技。
texts.en:
Our Observation Post above [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has been destroyed! The culprit was a large surface-to-space missile launched from a military base controlled by the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName] supranational task force.

We are still not certain how they managed to track the station, since extensive precautions had been taken to conceal its existence from the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. One theory is that the natives have managed to reverse-engineer technologies looted from our downed shuttles.

label.zh: 这真是太不像话了！
label.en: This is outrageous!

texts.zh:
由[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]各国组建、用以阻挠我们在[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上行动的跨国界特遣部队被解散了！尽管在针对我们穿梭机和绑架小队的行动中，他们设法取得了几个关键的胜利，但其中几个初创国家决定撤资，从这个计划中抽离。

情报显示，这一预料之外的转折事件是因为[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]各国之间的内斗和外交纠纷。
texts.en:
The supranational task force that the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName] nation states founded to thwart our operations on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has been disbanded! Though they somehow managed to achieve a few key victories against our shuttles and abduction teams, several of the organization's founding members decided to cut off funding and withdraw from the project.

Intelligence puts this unexpected turn of events down to infighting and diplomatic posturing between the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName] nation states.

label.zh: 虽然始料未及，但这样的发展也挺好。
label.en: A welcome, if unexpected, development.

texts.zh:
我们位于[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]轨道上的观测站的工作人员要求我们帮助处理由[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]建立的反外星人特遣部队，后者因为我们激进的观测工作而建立。尽管以我们的标准来说，这个组织相当原始，但它已经发展到能够对我们的绑架行动产生干扰。

他们的主基地已经确定位于[pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]地表，[pre_ftl_planet.GetAMountainFeature]深处。轨道轰炸效果不佳，但由一支全副武装的突击队进行快速袭击应该可以攻其不备突。若是能将其摧毁，对于冥顽不化的[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]特遣部队将是致命的一击。
texts.en:
The staff of our Observation Post orbiting [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has requested help in dealing with the anti-alien task force founded by the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural] in response to our aggressive observation efforts. Though archaic by our standards, this organization has developed a knack for disrupting our abduction operations.

Their main base has been identified on the [pre_ftl_planet.GetPlanetHabitat]'s surface, deep inside [pre_ftl_planet.GetAMountainFeature]. Orbital bombardment will be ineffective, but a swift raid by a heavily armed strike team should be able to take the base by surprise. Its destruction will surely spell the end of this irksome [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName] task force.

label.zh: 就这么办。
label.en: Make it happen.

label.zh: 不，我们应该避免进一步挑衅他们……
label.en: No, we should avoid antagonizing them further...

texts.zh:
我们计划摧毁[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]跨国界特遣部队主基地的任务大获全胜！我们的强袭小队渗透进了基地，在我们训练有素的特工面前，拿着低劣武器的基地守卫完全不是对手。

在基地内部装完炸药之后，我们的强袭小队被数艘等待的穿梭机接走。这支烦人的[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]特遣部队现在已经不剩什么了。
texts.en:
Our mission to destroy the main base of the [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName] supranational task force was a complete success! The base was infiltrated by our strike team, and its defenders and their limited weapons proved no match for our skilled operatives.

After planting explosive charges deep within the bowels of the base, the strike team were exfiltrated by waiting shuttles. Nothing remains of this troublesome [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName] task force now.

label.zh: 任务成功。
label.en: Mission successful.

texts.zh:
我们计划摧毁[pre_ftl_country.Owner.GetSpeciesName]跨国界特遣部队主基地的任务以一败涂地告终！数艘载着我们强袭小队的穿梭机还未到达基地就被隐蔽的防空炮台击落了。其余特工在到达基地入口时遇到了计划之外的顽强抵抗。

考虑到[pre_ftl_country.Owner.GetSpeciesName]的增援部队正在接近，强袭小队的指挥官最后下达了撤退的命令。然而不幸的是，我们返回轨道的穿梭机在途中遭到了大量大气层战斗机的拦截。损失惨重。
texts.en:
Our mission to destroy the main base of the [pre_ftl_country.Owner.GetSpeciesName] supranational task force failed miserably! Several of the shuttles carrying our strike team were brought down by hidden anti-aircraft emplacements before they even made it to the base. The remaining operatives met with unexpectedly stiff resistance when they eventually reached the base entrance.

In light of approaching [pre_ftl_country.Owner.GetSpeciesName] reinforcements, the strike team commander finally gave the order to retreat. Unfortunately, as our exfiltration shuttles were blasting their way into orbit, a massive formation of atmospheric fighters intercepted them. Losses were heavy.

label.zh: 这真是一场灾难！
label.en: This is a disaster!

texts.zh: 来自[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的[pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName]民族国家已经联合在一起并组建了反抗外星人的军事力量，其使命便是阻扰我们在这个星球的行动。这是不能容忍的。我们必须对其主基地进行一次惩罚性的打击。
texts.en: The [pre_ftl_country.GetSpeciesName] nation states on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have banded together and formed an anti-alien task force with the mission to thwart our operations on their homeworld. This cannot be tolerated. We must launch a punitive strike against the main base of this organization.
